content.text:
I've submitted index 13 (Sb fraction 0.21) as the best composition. At 0.047% it had the highest EQE of the five I measured, but that lead is tiny, so I can't say it's the true best on the line.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.07 | 0.043 |
| **13** | **0.21** | **0.047** |
| 16 | 0.28 | 0.041 |
| 22 | 0.45 | 0.044 |
| 28 | 0.63 | 0.034 |

- **Response is flat and low:** EQE stayed between 0.034% and 0.047% along the whole line. That fits yttrium–antimony oxides, which mostly don't absorb 2.7 eV light. Only the most Sb-rich end (index 28) is clearly lower.
- **Weak ranking:** index 13 beats the next-best measurement by about 0.003 percentage points. I don't know the measurement noise, so the true peak could be somewhere in the unmeasured gaps.
- **Budget:** I used all 5 EQE measurements but none of the 5 XRD measurements. That leaves unconfirmed my guess that the best spot sits near the Y₃SbO₇ phase (Sb fraction 0.25).
